mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE backward AS ( SELECT g.id, g.userId, g.goodsId, g.addressId, g.preId, g.goodsName, g.describe, g.goodsPrice, g.goodsStock, g.imagePath, g.launch, g.createTime, g.delete FROM goods g WHERE g.goodsId = #{goodsId} AND g.`delete` = 0 UNION ALL SELECT g.id, g.userId, g.goodsId, g.addressId, g.preId, g.goodsName, g.describe, g.goodsPrice, g.goodsStock, g.imagePath, g.launch, g.createTime, g.delete FROM goods g INNER JOIN backward b ON g.id = b.preId ), forward AS ( SELECT g.id, g.userId, g.goodsId, g.addressId, g.preId, g.goodsName, g.describe, g.goodsPrice, g.goodsStock, g.imagePath, g.launch, g.createTime, g.delete FROM goods g WHERE g.goodsId = #{goodsId} AND g.`delete` = 0 UNION ALL SELECT g.id, g.userId, g.goodsId, g.addressId, g.preId, g.goodsName, g.describe, g.goodsPrice, g.goodsStock, g.imagePath, g.launch, g.createTime, g.delete FROM goods g INNER JOIN forward f ON g.preId = f.id ) SELECT gc.id, u.userName, gc.goodsName, CONCAT(ad.country, ad.province, ad.city, ad.county, ad.detail) AS address, gc.goodsPrice, gc.goodsStock, gc.imagePath, gc.launch, gc.preId, gc.createTime, gc.delete, gc.describe FROM ( SELECT * FROM backward UNION SELECT * FROM forward ) gc LEFT JOIN user u ON gc.userId = u.id LEFT JOIN address ad ON gc.addressId = ad.id ORDER BY gc.id ASC
